subtasks.title: Develop Custom Resource Override System
subtasks.description: Create custom components to replace or augment existing ones.
subtasks.details:
Design and implement custom resource override system components.
<info added on 2025-07-22T09:30:03.270Z>
The resource override system is complete and working correctly for the Mission Area Planner integration. 

CustomOverrideInterceptor Implementation:
- Extends QQmlAbstractUrlInterceptor for resource redirection
- Intercepts QML file requests with "qrc" scheme
- Checks for custom overrides with ":/Custom" prefix
- Redirects to custom resources when they exist
- Falls back to original resources when custom versions don't exist

QML Engine Configuration:
- CustomPlugin::createQmlApplicationEngine() sets up the system
- Adds custom import path: `_qmlEngine->addImportPath("qrc:/Custom/Widgets")`
- Registers MissionAreaPlanner C++ class: `qmlRegisterType<MissionAreaPlanner>("QGroundControl.PlanView", 1, 0, "MissionAreaPlanner")`
- Installs CustomOverrideInterceptor: `_qmlEngine->addUrlInterceptor(_selector)`

Resource Override Logic:
- Intercepts QML file requests (DataType::QmlFile, DataType::UrlString)
- Constructs override path: `QStringLiteral(":/Custom%1").arg(origPath)`
- Checks if custom resource exists with QFile::exists()
- Returns custom URL if found, original URL if not found
- Handles cleanup in CustomPlugin::cleanup()

Integration Points:
- PlanView.qml is successfully overridden with MissionAreaPlannerPanel
- All custom QML components are accessible through resource system
- MissionAreaPlanner C++ backend is properly registered with QML
- Custom color palette and branding are applied
</info added on 2025-07-22T09:30:03.270Z>
